name: Bistro Toskana
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Bistro Toskana in Tirol!**

Discover authentic Mediterranean flavors in the heart of the Alps. Our cozy bistro invites you to savor delicious dishes inspired by the sunny shores of Greece and Italy—right here in the stunning landscape of Tirol.

Start your day with a fresh **Griechischer Salat** or a hearty **Mediterraner Frühstücksbrunch**. For lunch, indulge in our famous **Moussaka** or a classic **Pasta alla Carbonara**, paired with a crisp glass of local **Tiroler Wein**.

In the evening, unwind with a romantic dinner featuring our signature **Gefüllte Paprika** or a succulent **Mediterranes Grillgericht**. Don’t miss our decadent **Tiramisu** or a warm slice of **Apfelstrudel** for dessert.

Whether you’re exploring **Innsbruck**, skiing in the **Arlberg**, or hiking through the **Zillertal**, Bistro Toskana is your perfect retreat. Come taste the sun in Tirol!
